item.title: The EU AI Act: Everything Digital Creators Need to Know
item.description: Most digital creators I talk to think the EU AI Act means one thing: slap an “AI-generated” tag on your video and move on. It doesn’t. Article 50 is the part with a hard deadline — 2 August 2026 — so it gets all the attention. But it’s one article inside a bigger framework, and creators who only prepare for the label are missing the parts that actually restrict how they can build and use AI tools.

item.title: How to add AI disclosures that comply with the EU AI Act
item.description: The EU AI Act’s transparency obligations under Article 50 apply from 2 August 2026 — and if you publish AI-generated content professionally, you have specific disclosure duties that go well beyond adding a footnote to your terms and conditions. The European Commission has published draft guidelines explaining exactly what those disclosures must look like, where they must appear, and what will not meet the standard. This guide translates those requirements into practical placement guidance for content creators, freelancers, and science communicators.
